metadata.title: How to make brown stock?  Back to basics episode 2
metadata.description:
In this video, I'll show you how to make a rich and flavorful brown stock, a fundamental base for many classic dishes. Brown stock is perfect for soups, stews, sauces, and gravies, adding depth and complexity to your recipes. Learn how to roast bones, select the right vegetables, and simmer everything to perfection. Whether you're a home cook or just starting out, this step-by-step guide will give you the confidence to make your own brown stock from scratch. 

Don't forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more cooking basics!

#CookingBasics #BrownStock #HomemadeStock #KitchenEssentials #CookingFromScratch
